title: Entitlement & SKU Alignment: Migration runbook and release coordination
creator: Aisha Patel
description: High-level ticket to coordinate SKU/entitlement changes, billing limit harmonization, and all cross-functional tasks required for the March pricing repack. Deliverables: migration runbook (customer-facing and internal), final release notes, billing migration schedule, sales enablement assets, and support remediation playbooks. This ticket centralizes stakeholders, key decisions, and blockers so the PM team can sign off on go/no-go two weeks before cutover.
acceptance_criteria: Finalized SKU mapping table published to /confluence/pricing-repack and linked in release notes
Billing system migration plan validated with Finance and Billing eng (downtime/Rollback defined)
Sales enablement package (playbook + FAQ + slide deck) delivered and reviewed by GTM leads
Support runbook (escalations, billing disputes template, refund flows) published and tested in staging
Release notes drafted, reviewed by Legal and Security, and scheduled for customer communication windows
checklist: Confirm final SKU names and canonical IDs with Product Ops
Lock limits/quota bands and validate metering logic with Billing eng
Verify analytics tagging for entitlement attribution (Console + API)
Create migration scripts and dry-run on subset of customers
Schedule email and in-console notices with Communications
Prepare rollback steps and verification tests
